name: Starship Thrusters Damaged
description: Rogue Trader, Table 8-12, result 4 (p. 222). How badly the manoeuvring thrusters were hit.

results.name: Slowed
results.text: The ship can still manoeuvre, albeit slowly. Manoeuvrability bonus drops by -20. Repairable.

results.name: Thrusters Wrecked
results.text: The thrusters are completely damaged and the ship cannot turn. Repairable.
